Replacement bus service NL3 operates between Archway and High Barnet via Highgate, East Finchley, Finchley Central, West Finchley (Ballards Lane), Woodside Park (North Finchley High Road), and Totteridge & Whetstone (Whetstone High Road). Use London Buses route 382 between Finchley Central and Mill Hill East and Night Bus N20 between Archway and High Barnet during Night Tube hours.

Windrush.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Saturday 29, Sunday 30 and Monday 31 August, no service between Surrey Quays and Clapham Junction / Battersea Park. Replacement bus service M operates between Canada Water and Clapham Junction via Surrey Quays, Queens Road Peckham, Peckham Rye, Denmark Hill, Clapham High Street and Wandsworth Road. There will also be no SOUTHERN services at Queens Road Peckham and Peckham Rye, with an additional replacement bus service between London Bridge and Tulse Hill. SOUTHEASTERN and THAMESLINK trains continue to serve Peckham Rye and Denmark Hill.
